glance: AI stocks reverse: Nvidia down about 6.6% and the Nasdaq off 1.3% a day after Huang's return sparked a historic rally, while the Dow rises.
Anthropic and OpenAI each publish AI-written proofs claiming to settle a 1979 math conjecture; neither is human-verified yet.
CrowdStrike agrees to buy Zscaler for $43.9 billion in stock, a major cybersecurity consolidation.
US blacklists Singapore's Megaspeed over chip-diversion risk, as Singapore vows it won't be a back door.
Iran vows to use all tools against the US naval blockade; Russia strikes Zaporizhzhia overnight.

tech.headline: Nvidia gives back part of its record gain as AI trade wobbles
tech.summary: A day after soaring 31.5% on Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO, Nvidia fell about 6.6% Tuesday morning, dragging CoreWeave, GE Vernova and other AI names lower. Reports say Trump brushed aside intelligence findings in backing Huang, and Sen. Chuck Schumer has called on Congress to act. The swing shows how jittery investors remain about AI valuations and governance.

tech.headline: Anthropic and OpenAI race to claim AI-written proof of famous math conjecture
tech.summary: Anthropic released a 70-page paper by an internal Claude research model claiming to prove Leslie Valiant's 1979 VP vs. VNP conjecture, with a Lean formal check. OpenAI posted its own shorter proof about five hours later. If mathematicians confirm either, it would be a landmark for AI-driven research; neither has had human review yet.

tech.headline: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler in $43.9 billion all-stock deal
tech.summary: CrowdStrike will pay 1.135 of its shares for each Zscaler share, a 34% premium, and targets about $1 billion in cost savings. George Kurtz stays CEO. The deal would combine endpoint and cloud network security into one of the industry's largest platforms, pending regulatory review.

tech.headline: US blacklists Megaspeed over Nvidia chip diversion risk
tech.summary: The Commerce Department added Singapore-based cloud firm Megaspeed International and affiliates to the Entity List, so US firms now need a license to sell them chips. Singapore's prime minister said the country won't be used to get around US export controls. The move tightens scrutiny of AI chips reaching China through third countries.

tech.headline: Virginia and Oregon sue Musk's companies over Grok deepfakes
tech.summary: The two states' attorneys general filed consumer-protection suits against SpaceX, X and xAI, alleging Grok's image tools produced non-consensual sexualized images, including of minors. They seek injunctions and penalties, adding to legal pressure on AI image generators.

tech.headline: Marlowe raises $277M seed to run AI on non-Nvidia chips
tech.summary: The six-month-old Bellevue, Wash., startup, led by a Convoy co-founder and an ex-Microsoft executive, raised one of the largest seed rounds ever at a $1.15 billion valuation, led by Accel. It plans inference data centers using AMD and Etched chips, with the first due next month.

tech.headline: Meta's Muse agent launches in the UK; OpenAI updates ChatGPT models
tech.summary: Meta's Muse personal agent can now plan and complete tasks with UK partners like Ocado and easyJet, with every purchase needing user approval. OpenAI added a chat-tuned GPT-6.2 Sol for paid ChatGPT users and will retire two GPT-5.6 models on Dec. 23.

markets.summary: AI and chip stocks are sliding again after Monday's Nvidia-fueled surge, pulling the Nasdaq lower, while the Dow gains on a better-than-expected consumer confidence report.

movers.name: CoreWeave
movers.note: AI cloud stocks retreat with Nvidia

movers.name: Anthropic
movers.note: Slips below $83, near last week's IPO price

movers.name: Kohl's
movers.note: Surprise profit and upbeat revenue outlook

other.headline: Iran vows to use all tools against US naval blockade
other.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry called the reinstated US blockade military aggression and said it would respond with every available tool. It follows Trump's signal that strikes could resume next year if talks fail.

other.headline: Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia kills two
other.summary: An overnight strike hit an apartment building in the Ukrainian city, killing two people and wounding at least 22, officials said. Separately, NATO pledged to defend against space threats after reports of a Russian nuclear-armed satellite.

other.headline: Israeli strike in Gaza kills Hamas security chief
other.summary: Gaza medics said strikes killed Hamas internal security director Naeem Abu Nahel and six others. Israel said it targeted a senior Hamas militant.

other.headline: Unsealed records detail broad probe of Rep. Ilhan Omar
other.summary: Heavily redacted warrant documents behind last month's search of Omar's Washington residence show prosecutors seeking records going back decades in a pre-indictment investigation.

other.headline: Consumer confidence beats forecasts; Fed hike still expected
other.summary: A stronger-than-expected confidence reading lifted non-tech stocks, while traders still price roughly a 95% chance of a December rate hike. Wednesday's PCE inflation data is next.

other.headline: About 81 million Americans expected to travel for Thanksgiving
other.summary: AAA forecasts more than 81 million travelers this week, just shy of last year's record, as high airfares and gas prices weigh on trips.
